url.description: Full URL, or a path relative to the context_name API's base_url

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers as key-value string pairs

body.description: Request body (sent as JSON for POST/PUT/PATCH)

query_params.description: URL query parameters as key-value string pairs

context_name.description: Name of a stored ApiContext (list_apis): injects its auth and resolves a relative url against its base_url

pick.description: Optional list of field paths to KEEP from a JSON response body, projecting away everything else before returning. Shrinks a large payload so a downstream local LLM step does not overflow its context. Path forms: `field` or `a.b` (a top-level/nested value); `arr[].field` or `arr[].a.b` (keep those fields on each element of the array at `arr`); `arr[]` (keep each element whole); `[].field` (the response body is itself an array). Missing paths are skipped silently. Non-JSON bodies are returned unchanged. e.g. ["total","jobs[].title","jobs[].company_name","jobs[].apply_url"].
